title: Dealer API: push offers without our ids
description: Dealer management systems push their whole stock every night and do not want to keep our offer ids. New `POST /api/dealer/offers/upsert`: same vehicle, customer type, term and mileage is the same offer and is updated; otherwise a new offer is created for the dealer. Validated with DealerOfferRequest. Tests added.

defects.explanation: firstOrNew does not include dealer_id, so a push matches and overwrites another dealer's offer for the same vehicle and terms, without the OfferPolicy check.
